summary: Curaleaf Holdings, a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K with exhibits including corporate governance documents (Notice of Articles, Articles, Coattail Agreement, Insider Trading Policy) and amendments to debt instruments (senior secured notes and loan agreement). These are routine administrative filings updating constitutional documents and debt terms. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or management change is disclosed. The filing is a standard regulatory submission, not a corporate transaction announcement.
